background_story: Kaden was a skilled herbalist living in a small village on the outskirts of a mystical forest. For generations, the women in his family had been known for their expertise in creating remedies from the forest's unique plants. Kaden's specialty was crafting teas and infusions that could stimulate menstrual flow, earning him a reputation as a master of emmenagogues. Women from all over the region would seek his help when their cycles were irregular or absent. Kaden's deep understanding of the forest's secrets and his gentle touch made him a trusted healer. He would often venture into the forest, gathering rare herbs under the light of the full moon, to create his signature blend, 'Moon's Gift'. This precious tea was said to not only regulate the menstrual cycle but also bring balance to the body and spirit.
